- Documentation and user-facing features remain unchanged from the previous version.

Initial release of Code Review Visualizer.

- Generate interactive HTML code review pages with risk tags, diff highlights, and file-level annotations.
- Supports PR summary pages, behavior comparisons (Before/After), and code walkthroughs with visualized trust boundaries.
- Clean, responsive GitHub-style layout; all CSS/JS is inlined for single-file portability.
- Risk tags use a clear color scheme: 🟢 safe, 🟡 worth a look, 🔴 needs attention.
- Designed for both code review clarity and team onboarding scenarios.
